title: Toggle switch
brief: A settings row with a title, a helper line and an on-state switch built from a labelled checkbox. The track darkens on hover and the switch gets a ring on keyboard focus.

inspiration.note: Took the label plus switch pairing with a thumb that slides in a track; ours is a native checkbox restyled, with the helper line under the title.
Took the darker track on hover and the visible focus ring on the track; the indigo palette and row card are ours.
